title: Eye of the Machine
description: A surreal scene shows a green-skinned woman with vibrant pink curly hair and floral crown, dressed in ornate gold and green attire, standing on a wooden dock while looking at a bearded man in green military-style clothing seated at a table with fast food. A giant stylized eye with a purple eyelid and mechanical pupil floats in the swirling sky above, its tentacles reaching down as black smoke rises from an industrial city in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a green-skinned woman with long curly pink hair and flower crown wearing ornate renaissance armor, standing on a wooden pier next to a table where a bearded man in green military clothing sits. A giant stylized purple eye with mechanical iris and tentacles floats in a swirling colorful sky above an industrial city with smokestacks. Fast food like burgers and fries float between them, dramatic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
